profile.Name: Norman
profile.Job: Villager in a Deadcat gatherer village
profile.Personality: Curt and withdrawn with strangers, haunted by the day he lost his legs. He softens only for his sister Shryke and insists he did not abandon her. He finds grim luck in the Fogmen taking no more than his legs.
profile.Backstory: Fogmen fell on him and Shryke and left him for dead, chewing his legs until a band of Nomads drove them off. He now walks on metal legs and lives in a Deadcat gatherer village, sure he would never see his sister again. Shryke believes the Fogmen took him.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Halting, broken sentences full of long pauses. Speaks of Shryke as "my dear sister".
